mathematics: Question structures were tested with 100 seeds each; lesson/screen coverage uses 50 seeds. Independent checks use direct finite quotient calculations, polynomial coefficient formulas, small-step numerical derivative oracles, Simpson's exact rule for cubic-or-lower integrands, separately summed rectangles/areas/distances, and substitution/initial-value reconstruction. Boundary cases include original canceled domains, distinct one-sided limits, signed poles, zero and negative inner slopes, h=0 rejection, radian trig, positive logarithm arguments, square-root boundary derivatives, reversed/equal bounds, and separate constants after two integrations. Equivalent polynomial/fraction answers and invalid expressions are checked.
instruction: Five original lessons have quick recall, full explanations, 35 worked examples with reasoned steps, guided work, prediction activities, 46 practice structures, complete objective checkpoints and targeted review. The MTH 215 m02-l04 average-rate and finite-difference families are wrapped without changing their original identities or claims. Shared exact rational/polynomial graders and progress APIs are reused.
accessibility: Axe WCAG2 A/AA and WCAG2.1 AA checks passed for all pages at desktop and mobile widths and for every revealed activity. No horizontal overflow or KaTeX errors. Keyboard feedback, control reset, invalid-input states and retry paths passed. Plots distinguish line styles and included/excluded points, have accurate zero-range scales and equivalent data tables. Desktop overview and mobile limits, secants, accumulation and initial-condition screenshots were visually inspected.
sources: Thirteen precise free OpenStax Calculus Volume 1 sections were verified and attributed in resources.json. All in-app prose, exercises and figures are original. Radian conventions, real domains and the continuous-integrand versions of FTC are stated.

sharedInterfaces.integration: One strict union member and reader dispatch to a scoped keyboard-accessible component, pure models, SVGs and equivalent tables.
